description: This file defines an abstract base class for entity display mode forms within Drupal's field_ui module, handling form building, saving, and display configuration logic.

classes.name: EntityDisplayModeFormBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for managing entity display mode forms, providing methods for form construction, display configuration, and saving display settings.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the form, setting entity type and display context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting bundle info and display repository services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class with services from the container.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, setting target entity type if not provided.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Defines form fields for name, description, id, and bundle enablement options.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a display mode with given ID already exists.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the entity display mode and manages related display configurations.

methods.name: getEntityDisplay
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate display object (view or form) based on context.

methods.name: getOverviewUrl
methods.description: Generates URL for editing specific display modes.

methods.name: getViewDisplay
methods.description: Loads a view display for a bundle and mode.

methods.name: getFormDisplay
methods.description: Loads a form display for a bundle and mode.

methods.name: getDisplayByContext
methods.description: Returns display object based on current display context (view or form).

methods.name: copyFormValuesToEntity
methods.description: Copies form values to entity, ensuring description is not empty.
